units.en: Explanation of the Resolution of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Certain Major Issues concerning Persevering with Full and Rigorous Party Self-Governance

units.zh: 习近平
units.en: Xi Jinping

units.zh: 同志们：
units.en: Comrades,

units.zh: 受中央政治局委托，我就《中共中央关于持之以恒推进全面从严治党若干重大问题的决定》（以下简称《决定》）起草的有关情况向全会作说明。
units.en: On behalf of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee, I will now brief you on the drafting of the Resolution of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Certain Major Issues concerning Persevering with Full and Rigorous Party Self-Governance.

units.zh: 一、关于确定全会议题的考虑
units.en: I. Considerations on the Topic of the Session

units.zh: 党的建设事关党的前途命运、党和国家事业兴衰成败。今年是我们党成立105周年。中央政治局决定，党的二十届五中全会重点研究持之以恒推进全面从严治党问题。这是党中央把握党和国家事业发展历史方位、着眼中国式现代化全局，审时度势、通盘考虑作出的重大决策。
units.en: Party building is crucial to the future of the Party and the success of the cause of the Party and the country. As this year marks the 105th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China (CPC), the Political Bureau decided that the 20th CPC Central Committee would focus on the issue of persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance at its fifth plenary session. This major decision made by the Central Committee is based on its assessment and thorough consideration of the situation and in light of the historical stage that the cause of the Party and the country has entered and the advancement of Chinese modernization as a whole.

units.zh: 第一，这是保持党的先进性和纯洁性、巩固党的长期执政地位的必然要求。
units.en: First, it is essential for maintaining the Party’s advanced nature and integrity and consolidating its long-term governing position.

units.zh: 如何跳出治乱兴衰历史周期率，是我们党长期执政必须回答好的根本问题。就此，当年毛泽东同志在延安窑洞里给出了“让人民来监督政府”的第一个答案，党的十八大以来我们在全面从严治党实践中找到“自我革命”的第二个答案。党的自我革命有严格的界定，就是刀刃向内，全面从严治党，保持党的先进性和纯洁性，实现党的自我净化、自我完善、自我革新、自我提高。100多年来，我们党在领导人民为实现中华民族伟大复兴不懈奋斗的历史进程中，一直高度重视管党治党，勇于坚持真理、修正错误，在依靠自身力量和人民支持解决自身问题中不断强大，百年大党充满活力、风华正茂。
units.en: For our Party to maintain its long-term governance, it is imperative to find answers to the fundamental question of how to escape the historical cycle of rise and fall. Comrade Mao Zedong offered the first answer to this question back in his years in the cave dwellings of Yan’an: the people’s oversight over government. Since the Party’s 18th National Congress, we have found the second answer in exercising full and rigorous self-governance: the Party’s self-reform. The Party’s self-reform has been defined clearly. It entails exercising full and rigorous self-governance with unflinching courage to ensure the Party maintains its advanced nature and integrity and can purify, improve, renew, and excel itself. For more than a century, our Party has led the people in working tirelessly for the rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. During the course, the Party has always attached great importance to its self-supervision and self-governance, had the courage to uphold truth and correct errors, and grown ever stronger by relying on its own efforts and the support of the people to resolve its own problems. Thanks to these efforts, our century-old Party remains in its prime, brimming with vigor and vitality.

units.zh: 同时，要清醒看到，全面从严治党是长期的战略性任务。这些年，党的队伍发生结构性变化，改革开放后出生的党员、干部比例越来越大，对教育管理提出新的要求。党的队伍主流是好的，但弱化党的先进性、损害党的纯洁性、影响党长期执政的问题和隐患还不少，特别是思想不纯、组织不纯、作风不纯问题尚未根本解决，一些新问题又不断产生。面对这些问题和挑战，只有通过持之以恒推进全面从严治党，不断清除侵蚀党的健康肌体的病毒，才能确保党永远不变质不变色不变味，确保红色江山代代相传。
units.en: At the same time, we must be keenly aware that full and rigorous Party self-governance is a long-term strategic task. Over the years, our Party membership is undergoing structural changes, with a steady increase in the proportion of members and officials born after the launch of reform and opening up in 1978. This has raised new requirements for education and management. The vast majority of Party members are exemplary, yet there remain a number of problems and hidden dangers that threaten to undermine the Party’s advanced nature, weaken its integrity, and jeopardize its long-term governance. In particular, the problems of defects in thinking, organization, and conduct have yet to be solved root and branch, while some new problems continue to emerge. Facing these problems and challenges, we must persevere with full and rigorous Party self-governance to remove the viruses that would erode the Party’s health, ensuring that the Party will never change its nature, its conviction, or its character, and that the socialist cause can be advanced from generation to generation.

units.zh: 第二，这是巩固和发展全党高度团结统一、党心军心民心高度凝聚良好政治局面的必然要求。
units.en: Second, it is essential for consolidating and developing the sound political situation where great solidarity and unity are maintained across the whole Party and great cohesion is secured within the Party and the military and among the people.

units.zh: 党的十八大之后，党中央直面一度出现党的领导弱化虚化淡化、管党治党不严不实不力、党内一些问题触目惊心的严峻现实，坚定不移全面从严治党，持续解决突出问题，从根本上扭转了管党治党宽松软状况，刹住了一些长期没有刹住的歪风，纠治了一些多年未除的顽瘴痼疾，消除了党、国家、军队内部存在的严重隐患，党在革命性锻造中更加坚强有力。党的全面领导和党中央集中统一领导显著加强，马克思主义中国化时代化实现新的飞跃，新时代党的组织路线贯彻有力，中央八项规定铁律生威，党的纪律建设扎实推进，反腐败斗争力度前所未有、成效有目共睹，党内法规制度体系更为完善，党的各级组织落实管党治党责任见行见效。新时代全面从严治党积累了丰富经验，开辟了百年大党自我革命新境界，党的团结统一更加巩固，党心军心民心高度凝聚。
units.en: Since the Party’s 18th National Congress, the Central Committee has confronted the grave situation marked by weak, hollow, and watered-down Party leadership, lax, superficial, and ineffective self-supervision and self-governance, as well as some egregious problems within the Party. Staying firmly committed to full and rigorous Party self-governance, the Central Committee has made continuous efforts to tackle these prominent issues. As a result, the problem of lax and weak self-supervision and self-governance has been addressed at its root, unhealthy tendencies that had long gone unchecked have been curbed, deep-seated problems that had plagued the Party for years have been remedied, and serious dangers hidden within the Party, the state, and the military have been removed. The Party has thus grown stronger through revolutionary tempering. Thanks to these efforts, we have significantly strengthened the Party’s overall leadership and the centralized, unified leadership of the Central Committee; achieved a new breakthrough in adapting Marxism to the Chinese context and the needs of our times; and effectively implemented the Party’s organizational line for the new era. The central Party leadership’s eight-point decision on improving work conduct has begun to show its teeth as ironclad discipline, and steady progress has been made in strengthening Party discipline. We have combated corruption with unprecedented intensity and produced universally recognized results. The framework of Party regulations and institutions has been further improved, and Party organizations at all levels have taken concrete and effective measures to fulfill their responsibilities for self-supervision and self-governance. We have gained rich experience in full and rigorous Party self-governance in the new era and broken new ground in the self-reform of our century-old Party. As a result, we have reinforced the solidarity and unity of the Party and secured great cohesion within the Party and the military and among the people.

units.zh: 这一良好政治局面来之不易，全党必须倍加珍惜，不断加以巩固和发展。这就要求我们坚持和运用新时代全面从严治党宝贵经验，以更高标准、更实举措持之以恒推进全面从严治党，不断增强党的政治领导力、思想引领力、群众组织力、社会号召力，确保党永远得到人民衷心拥护、始终成为中国特色社会主义事业的坚强领导核心。
units.en: As such a sound political situation has not been easily won, the whole Party must cherish it and continue to consolidate and develop it. This requires us, building on our valuable experience gained in the new era, to adopt higher standards and more concrete measures in persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance and constantly strengthen the Party’s capacity for providing political leadership, giving theoretical guidance, organizing the people, and inspiring society. By doing so, we will see that the Party always enjoys the wholehearted support of the people and remains the strong leadership core in the cause of socialism with Chinese characteristics.

units.zh: 第三，这是实现党的历史使命、推动党和国家事业行稳致远的必然要求。
units.en: Third, it is essential for fulfilling the Party’s historic mission and ensuring steady and sustained progress in the cause of the Party and the country.

units.zh: 以中国式现代化全面推进强国建设、民族复兴伟业，是前无古人的开创性事业。经过党的十八大以来全党全国各族人民的顽强奋斗，党和国家事业取得历史性成就、发生历史性变革，实现中华民族伟大复兴进入不可逆转的历史进程。同时，世界之变、时代之变、历史之变正以前所未有的方式展开，前进道路上面临多种风险和挑战。从国际看，世界百年未有之大变局加速演进，新一轮科技革命和产业变革加速突破，国际力量对比深刻调整，世界进入新的动荡变革期，外部环境不确定难预料因素增多。从国内看，历经40多年改革开放，我国经济社会生活发生巨大变迁，发展不平衡不充分问题仍然突出，进一步全面深化改革、推动高质量发展、加强社会建设和治理、统筹发展和安全、激发和增强社会活力等遇到不少新课题。
units.en: Building a great country and advancing national rejuvenation on all fronts through Chinese modernization is a pioneering endeavor that no one has attempted before. Thanks to the tenacious efforts of the whole Party and the people of all ethnic groups since the Party’s 18th National Congress, we have brought about historic achievements and transformations in the cause of the Party and the country, setting the rejuvenation of the Chinese nation on an irreversible historical course. At the same time, however, with the world, the times, and the course of history changing in ways like never before, we will be confronted with multiple risks and challenges on our journey ahead. Internationally, momentous changes of a magnitude not seen in a century are unfolding across the world at a faster pace. Breakthroughs are accelerating in the new round of technological revolution and industrial transformation, while a profound shift is taking place in the international balance of power. As the world enters a new period of turbulence and transformation, uncertainties and unforeseeable factors are increasing in our country’s external environment. Domestically, more than 40 years of reform and opening up have brought about tremendous changes in China’s economy and society. However, development imbalances and inadequacies remain prominent, and many new challenges have emerged in further deepening reform comprehensively, promoting high-quality development, strengthening social development and governance, ensuring both development and security, and stimulating and boosting the vitality of our society.

units.zh: 办好中国的事情，关键在党，关键在全面从严治党。面对错综复杂的国际国内形势和艰巨繁重的改革发展稳定任务，推动中国式现代化行稳致远，必须大力弘扬伟大建党精神、始终牢记“三个务必”、不断发扬党的优秀特质，持之以恒推进全面从严治党，把我们党建设得更好、更强，为全面建成社会主义现代化强国、以中国式现代化全面推进中华民族伟大复兴提供坚强保障。
units.en: China’s success hinges on our Party, especially on the Party’s efforts to exercise full and rigorous self-governance. In the face of complicated international and domestic landscapes and the challenging tasks of advancing reform, promoting development, and ensuring stability, it is essential, in our efforts to ensure steady and sustained progress in Chinese modernization, to carry forward the great founding spirit and fine qualities of the Party, and always bear in mind that all of us in the Party must never forget our original aspiration and founding mission, that we must always stay modest, prudent, and hard-working, and that we must have the courage and ability to carry on our fight. We must also persevere with full and rigorous Party self-governance, and work to make our Party better and stronger, so as to provide strong guarantees for building China into a great modern socialist country in all respects and advancing the rejuvenation of the Chinese nation on all fronts through Chinese modernization.

units.zh: 二、关于《决定》稿的起草过程
units.en: II. The Drafting Process

units.zh: 今年1月，党中央成立党的二十届五中全会文件起草组，由我担任组长，王沪宁、蔡奇、李希同志担任副组长，党和国家有关领导同志及有关中央部门和地方负责同志参加，在中央政治局常委会领导下开展工作。2月6日，文件起草组召开第一次全体会议，正式启动文件起草工作。
units.en: In January this year, the Central Committee established a document drafting group for the fifth plenary session of the 20th Central Committee under the leadership of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau. I was chief of this group, while my colleagues Wang Huning, Cai Qi, and Li Xi served as its deputy chiefs. The group also included other Party and state leaders as well as heads of relevant central departments and localities. On February 6, the group convened its first general meeting, starting the drafting work officially.

units.zh: 文件起草中，着重把握了以下几点。
units.en: Throughout the drafting process, we have highlighted the following points.

units.zh: 第一，全面贯彻新时代党建思想。
units.en: First, fully implement the Thought on Party Building for a new era

units.zh: 新时代党建思想是新时代中国特色社会主义思想的党建篇，是党和人民实践经验和集体智慧的结晶。《决定》稿起草坚持以新时代党建思想为指导，在文件框架安排、总结成就和经验、分析形势和任务、明确指导思想和原则、提出政策举措上全面落实这一思想的要求，遵循马克思主义执政党建设规律，充分运用新时代全面从严治党宝贵经验，着力推动管党治党、兴党强党在守正中创新、在继承中发展。
units.en: The Thought on Party Building for a new era represents the Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era in the sphere of Party building. It stands as a crystallization of the practical experience and collective wisdom of the Party and the people. In drafting the document, we have followed the guidance of the Thought on Party Building for a new era and fully applied the requirements of this Thought in defining the framework of the document, reviewing the achievements and experience, analyzing the circumstances and tasks, clarifying the guiding philosophy and principles, and putting forth policy measures. We have also followed the laws underlying the development of a Marxist governing party and made the most of the valuable experience in exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance in the new era, aiming to seek development while carrying forward fine traditions and break new ground while upholding fundamental principles in the efforts to supervise, govern, develop, and strengthen the Party.

units.zh: 第二，服务使命任务。
units.en: Second, serve the Party’s missions and tasks

units.zh: 服从服务于党和国家事业发展，历来是党的建设的重要原则。《决定》稿起草坚持不忘初心、牢记使命，着眼于实现新时代新征程党的使命任务，注重把握管党治党、兴党强党和强国建设、民族复兴的内在联系，谋划提出各项政策举措都紧扣党和国家事业发展需要，确保持之以恒推进全面从严治党各方面部署都围绕中心、服务大局。
units.en: Complying with and serving the cause of the Party and the country has always been a major principle guiding Party building. In drafting the document, we have stayed true to the Party’s original aspiration and founding mission, while bearing in mind the Party’s missions and tasks on the new journey in the new era. Taking into account the inherent connection between efforts to supervise, govern, develop, and strengthen the Party on the one hand, and the goal of building a great country and advancing national rejuvenation on the other, we have formulated policy measures in line with the development of the cause of the Party and the country, ensuring that all of our arrangements for persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance focus on the central task and serve the overall interests.

units.zh: 第三，坚持严的基调。
units.en: Third, stay committed to rigorous governance

units.zh: 全面从严治党关键在严，持之以恒推进全面从严治党必须一以贯之、一严到底。《决定》稿起草牢牢把握党的建设各项工作标准要严，对各级党组织和党员、干部的教育管理监督要严，对不良作风和腐败现象整治措施要严，落实管党治党责任要严的要求，进一步深化和完善全面从严治党各项政策举措，鲜明释放越往后越严的强烈信号。同时，坚持严管厚爱结合、激励约束并重，做到既严格到位、约束到位，又激发全党积极性主动性创造性。
units.en: Being rigorous is the key to exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance. To persevere with the efforts in this regard, we must remain committed to rigorous governance through to the end. In drafting the resolution, we have firmly adhered to the principle of being rigorous in the following aspects: the implementation of standards in all initiatives of Party building; education, management, and oversight of Party organizations at all levels, Party members, and officials; the enforcement of the measures to address misconduct and corruption; and the fulfillment of responsibilities for Party self-supervision and self-governance. By further refining the policies and measures for full and rigorous Party self-governance, we have sent a strong signal of our commitment to being even more rigorous in the years ahead. At the same time, we should be strict with and also care for Party members and officials, and place equal emphasis on providing incentives and imposing constraints. In this way, we will ensure strict constraints on them while stimulating greater motivation, initiative, and creativity within the whole Party.

units.zh: 第四，突出问题导向。
units.en: Fourth, adopt a problem-oriented approach

units.zh: 全面从严治党是针对党内突出问题而展开的，持之以恒推进全面从严治党必须在巩固已有成果基础上不断研究新情况、解决新问题。《决定》稿抓住关键要害、聚焦突出问题谋篇布局。谋划思路举措坚持有什么问题就解决什么问题、什么问题突出就重点解决什么问题，找准问题症结，深入研究论证，提出有针对性的对策。
units.en: Our efforts in exercising full and rigorous self-governance aim at addressing prominent problems within the Party. To advance this work, we must continue to study new developments and solve new problems on the basis of consolidating the achievements already made. Therefore, the draft resolution has been laid out by highlighting pivotal issues and prominent problems. In devising plans and measures, we have adopted an approach that addresses whatever problems that come up, and focused on the most pressing ones. We have strived to pinpoint the crux of these problems and put forward targeted solutions based on in-depth analysis and deliberation.

units.zh: 第五，强化系统观念。
units.en: Fifth, enhance systems thinking

units.zh: 持之以恒推进全面从严治党是一项系统工程，必须把党的政治建设、思想建设、组织建设、作风建设、纪律建设和制度建设、反腐败斗争等作为一个有机整体来谋划和推进，着力健全全面从严治党体系。
units.en: Persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance is a systematic endeavor. We must take a holistic approach in planning and advancing the efforts to strengthen the Party politically, theoretically, and organizationally, as well as in terms of conduct, discipline, and institutions, and to combat corruption, with a focus on improving the system of exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance.

units.zh: 《决定》稿起草全面落实新时代党的建设总要求，坚持以党的政治建设为统领，注重党的各方面建设协同发力、各项政策措施衔接配套，注重以上率下、点面结合、标本兼治，注重形成上下贯通、条块结合、齐抓共管的工作格局，切实增强管党治党整体效能。
units.en: The draft resolution fully applies the overall requirements for Party building in the new era. Taking strengthening the Party politically as the overarching principle, it stresses coordinated efforts on all fronts of Party building and integration of all policies and measures. It also highlights the importance of leveraging the exemplary role of leading officials, focusing on both overall work and efforts in specific areas, addressing both symptoms and root causes, and establishing a working mechanism featuring cross-level alignment, concerted efforts from all departments and localities, and joint efforts of all sides. Thus, the overall effectiveness of Party self-supervision and self-governance will be improved.

units.zh: 文件起草中，党中央充分发扬民主，深入调查研究，广泛征求意见。1月31日，党中央发出通知，就党的二十届五中全会议题征求各地区各部门意见。同时，委托16家单位就23个重点课题开展研究。5月6日，我在上海主持召开座谈会，听取部分省区市主要负责同志意见。8月3日，《决定》稿下发党内一定范围征求意见，包括征求党内部分老同志意见，还专门听取了各民主党派中央、全国工商联负责人和无党派人士代表意见。
units.en: During the drafting process, the Central Committee has promoted full democratic engagement, conducted thorough surveys and studies, and sought extensive input. On January 31, it issued a notice on soliciting opinions from all localities and departments on the topic of the fifth plenary session of the 20th Central Committee. Meanwhile, 16 organizations were entrusted to carry out research on 23 major issues. On May 6, I presided over a symposium in Shanghai to hear the opinions of the principal leaders of a number of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the central government. On August 3, a draft resolution was issued to certain Party members for feedback, including retired senior Party officials, and dedicated meetings were held to solicit views from the central committees of other political parties in China, leaders of the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce, and prominent figures without party affiliation.

units.zh: 各方面一致认为，党中央决定党的二十届五中全会重点研究持之以恒推进全面从严治党问题，充分体现了我们党对加强自身建设的高度清醒和坚强意志。《决定》稿就持之以恒推进全面从严治党作出战略部署，必将成为推进新时代党的建设新的伟大工程的纲领性文件，对于进一步开创新时代管党治党、兴党强党新局面，团结带领全国各族人民以中国式现代化全面推进强国建设、民族复兴伟业，具有重大现实意义和长远指导意义。
units.en: All those consulted unanimously agree that the Central Committee’s decision to focus on the topic of persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance at the fifth plenary session of the 20th Central Committee fully reflects our Party’s keen awareness and strong will to strengthen itself. Outlining a strategic plan for persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance, the resolution will undoubtedly serve as a programmatic document for advancing the great new project of Party building in the new era. It is of great immediate importance and far-reaching guiding significance for our endeavors to break new ground in supervising, governing, developing, and strengthening the Party in the new era and to lead the Chinese people of all ethnic groups in a concerted effort to build a great country and advance national rejuvenation on all fronts through Chinese modernization.

units.zh: 与此同时，各方面提出许多好的意见和建议，文件起草组逐条研究，能吸收的尽量吸收。
units.en: With regard to its formulation, various sides have contributed many valuable comments and suggestions. The drafting group studied them one by one and incorporated as many of them as possible into the document.

units.zh: 《决定》稿起草期间，中央政治局常委会召开3次会议、中央政治局召开2次会议进行审议、修改，形成提交这次全会审议的《决定》稿。
units.en: During the drafting process, the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau met three times and the Political Bureau convened on two occasions to review and revise draft versions of the document. These efforts culminated in the final draft that we have submitted to this plenary session for deliberation.

units.zh: 三、关于《决定》稿的基本框架和主要内容
units.en: III. General Framework and Main Content

units.zh: 《决定》稿除了开头语和结束语，分三大板块。
units.en: In addition to the opening paragraph and a conclusion, the draft resolution consists of three sections.

units.zh: 第一板块为第一部分，是总论。阐述持之以恒推进全面从严治党的重要性紧迫性和总体要求，共5个方面内容。一是回顾100多年来我们党一以贯之加强党的建设、团结带领人民不断从胜利走向胜利的光辉历程。二是总结党的十八大以来全面从严治党取得的伟大成就，阐述形成新时代党建思想的重大意义。三是分析全面从严治党面临的新形势新任务新挑战。四是提出持之以恒推进全面从严治党的指导思想。五是阐明持之以恒推进全面从严治党遵循的7条原则。
units.en: The first section, Part I, gives an overview. It elaborates on the importance, urgency, and overall requirements of persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance from five aspects. First, it reviews our Party’s glorious journey over more than 100 years, along which it has consistently strengthened itself and united and led the people in winning one victory after another. Second, it summarizes the great achievements the Party has made in exercising full and rigorous self-governance since its 18th National Congress and explicates the profound significance of the Thought on Party Building for a new era. Third, it analyzes the new circumstances, tasks, and challenges our Party faces in exercising full and rigorous self-governance. Fourth, it puts forward the guiding philosophy for persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance. Fifth, it sets forth seven guiding principles that we must follow in advancing the efforts in this regard.

units.zh: 第二板块是分论，包括第二部分至第八部分。部署持之以恒推进全面从严治党的战略任务和重大举措。
units.en: The second section is the discussion section, which runs from the second through eighth parts. It makes arrangements for strategic tasks and major measures for persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance.

units.zh: 其中，第二部分“增强共产党人的党性”，强调这是全面从严治党的根本性任务，从强化对党忠诚教育、坚持用党的创新理论凝心铸魂、用党的优良传统和中华优秀传统文化涵养党性、在实践中锤炼党性、加强党性鉴别等5个方面作出部署。
units.en: The second part focuses on strengthening the Party spirit of communists, which represents a fundamental task in our efforts to ensure full and rigorous Party self-governance. The main points include: strengthening education on loyalty to the Party; building cohesion and inner strength with the Party’s new theories; nurturing the Party spirit with the Party’s good traditions and fine traditional Chinese culture; tempering the Party spirit in practice; enhancing Party spirit appraisal.

units.zh: 第三部分“严格贯彻执行民主集中制”，强调这是全面从严治党的内在要求，从坚持和加强党中央集中统一领导、提高党内民主质量、严格执行领导班子决策议事规则、规范“一把手”履职用权等4个方面作出部署。
units.en: The third part makes it clear that strictly practicing democratic centralism is an inherent requirement for exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance. The main points include: upholding and strengthening the Party Central Committee’s centralized, unified leadership; improving the efficacy of intraparty democracy; strictly implementing deliberation rules and decision-making procedures for leadership teams; regulating leadership team heads’ performance of duties and exercise of power.

units.zh: 第四部分“锻造堪当民族复兴重任的高素质干部队伍”，强调全面从严治党关键在从严治吏，从坚持正确用人导向、精准科学选人用人、推动干部树立和践行正确政绩观、增强干部干事创业本领、提高培养选拔优秀年轻干部质量、加强干部管理监督等6个方面作出部署。
units.en: Under the heading of cultivating high-caliber officials capable of shouldering the mission of national rejuvenation, the fourth part emphasizes that strict management of officials is the key to full and rigorous governance over the Party. The main points include: following sound guidelines in appointing officials; taking targeted, well-designed measures to select and appoint officials; inspiring officials to foster and act on the correct view of performance; enhancing officials’ competence in fulfilling their duties and breaking new ground; improving the training and selection of outstanding young officials; strengthening management and oversight of officials.

units.zh: 第五部分“建设上下贯通、执行有力的严密组织体系”，强调党的各级组织是全面从严治党的主体，从发挥中央和国家机关党组织表率作用、强化地方党委功能、统筹推进各领域基层党组织建设、突出抓好新兴领域党的建设、加强党员队伍建设、完善党的各级组织贯通机制等6个方面作出部署。
units.en: The fifth part discusses building a well-knit organizational system characterized by cross-level alignment and effective implementation. Stressing that Party organizations at all levels play the principal role in exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance, it covers the following points: giving play to the exemplary role of Party organizations of central Party and state organs; bolstering the functions of local Party committees; taking coordinated steps to improve primary-level Party organizations across all sectors; promoting Party building in emerging sectors; building a strong contingent of Party members; refining mechanisms to ensure alignment across different levels of Party organizations.

units.zh: 第六部分“驰而不息正风肃纪”，强调这是全面从严治党的有力举措，从走好新时代党的群众路线、锲而不舍落实中央八项规定精神、推进作风建设常态化长效化、强化从严执纪、综合发挥纪律教育约束和保障激励作用等5个方面作出部署。
units.en: The sixth part stresses that improving conduct and tightening discipline on an ongoing basis are effective measures to advance full and rigorous Party self-governance. The main points include: following the Party’s mass line in the new era; steadfastly implementing the guiding principles from the central Party leadership’s eight-point decision on improving work conduct; devoting consistent and sustained efforts to improving conduct; making discipline enforcement more rigorous; making full use of discipline as a guide, restraint, guarantee, and incentive.

units.zh: 第七部分“坚定不移一体推进不敢腐不能腐不想腐”，强调这是全面从严治党的重要方略和反腐败斗争的基本方针，从保持惩治腐败高压态势、加强对权力运行的制约和监督、夯实崇廉拒腐思想根基、增强一体推进不敢腐不能腐不想腐综合效能等4个方面作出部署。
units.en: The seventh part defines taking firm and integrated action against corruption as both an important policy for full and rigorous Party self-governance and a fundamental principle for our fight against corruption. The main points include: maintaining a tough stance against corruption; strengthening checks on and oversight over the exercise of power; fortifying the cultural-ethical foundations for upholding integrity and resisting corruption; better preventing corruption through a holistic approach. Revolving around running the Party through institutions and regulations, the eighth part highlights strengthening Party regulations and institutions as a long-term, fundamental strategy for ensuring full and rigorous Party self-governance. The main points include: improving the framework of Party regulations and institutions; enhancing the implementation of institutions; eliminating hidden rules.

units.zh: 第三板块包括完善党和国家监督体系、落实全面从严治党政治责任。就这两方面分别作出部署。
units.en: The third section discusses improving Party and state oversight systems and fulfilling the political responsibility for full and rigorous Party self-governance. Specific arrangements are made therein.

units.zh: 同志们，
units.en: Comrades,

units.zh: 审议通过《决定》是这次全会的主要任务。大家要认真思考、深入讨论，提出建设性意见和建议，共同把这次全会开好、把《决定》稿修改好。
units.en: The key task of this plenary session is to review and adopt the resolution. I hope that all of you will give this draft your careful consideration, carry out in-depth discussions, and come up with constructive ideas and suggestions, so that we can work together to make this plenary session a success and make well-conceived revisions to the draft resolution.

files.name: 20251030习近平同美国总统特朗普在釜山举行会晤（外交部通稿）

units.zh: 习近平同美国总统特朗普在釜山举行会晤
units.en: President Xi Jinping Meets with U.S. President Donald J. Trump in Busan

units.zh: 当地时间2025年10月30日，国家主席习近平在釜山同美国总统特朗普举行会晤。
units.en: On October 30, 2025 local time, President Xi Jinping had a meeting with U.S. President Donald J. Trump in Busan.

units.zh: 习近平指出，中美关系在我们共同引领下，保持总体稳定。两国做伙伴、做朋友，这是历史的启示，也是现实的需要。两国国情不同，难免有一些分歧，作为世界前两大经济体，时而也会有摩擦，这很正常。面对风浪和挑战，两国元首作为掌舵人，应当把握好方向、驾驭住大局，让中美关系这艘大船平稳前行。我愿继续同特朗普总统一道，为中美关系打下一个稳固的基础，也为两国各自发展营造良好的环境。
units.en: President Xi noted that under our joint guidance, China-U.S. relations have remained stable on the whole. China and the United States should be partners and friends. This is what history has taught us and what reality needs. Given our different national conditions, we do not always see eye to eye with each other and it is normal for the two leading economies of the world to have frictions now and then. You and I are at the helm of China-U.S. relations. In the face of winds, waves and challenges, we should stay the right course, navigate through the complex landscape, and ensure the steady sailing forward of the giant ship of China-U.S. relations. I am ready to continue working with you to build a solid foundation for China-U.S. relations and create a sound atmosphere for the development of both countries.

units.zh: 习近平强调，中国经济发展势头不错，今年前三季度增长率达5.2%，对全球的货物贸易进出口增长4%，这是克服内外困难实现的，来之不易。中国经济是一片大海，规模、韧性、潜力都比较大，我们有信心也有能力应对各种风险挑战。
units.en: President Xi emphasized that there is a good momentum in China’s economic development. In the first three quarters of this year, China’s economy increased by 5.2 percent, and import and export trade in goods with the rest of the world expanded by 4 percent. This is not an easy accomplishment given the domestic and external difficulties. The Chinese economy is like a vast ocean, big, resilient and promising. We have the confidence and capability to navigate all kinds of risks and challenges.

units.zh: 中共二十届四中全会审议通过了未来5年的国民经济和社会发展规划建议。70多年来，我们坚持一张蓝图绘到底，一茬接着一茬干，从来没有想挑战谁、取代谁，而是集中精力办好自己的事，做更好的自己，同世界各国分享发展机遇。这是中国成功的重要密码。中国将进一步全面深化改革、扩大对外开放，着力推动经济实现质的有效提升和量的合理增长，推进人的全面发展和全体人民共同富裕，相信这也将为中美合作开辟更广阔空间。
units.en: At its fourth plenary session, the 20th CPC Central Committee deliberated over and adopted the recommendations for the economic and social development plan over the next five years. Over the past seven decades and more, we have been working from generation to generation on the same blueprint to make it a reality. We have no intention to challenge or supplant anyone. Our focus has always been on managing China’s own affairs well, improving ourselves, and sharing development opportunities with all countries across the world. And that is an important secret to our success. China will further deepen reform across the board, expand opening up, and promote higher-quality economic growth while achieving an appropriate increase in economic output, and advance well-rounded human development and common prosperity for all. This will also expand the space for cooperation between China and the United States.

units.zh: 习近平指出，两国经贸团队就重要经贸问题深入交换意见，形成了解决问题的共识。双方团队要尽快细化和敲定后续工作，将共识维护好、落实好，以实实在在的成果，给中美两国和世界经济吃下一颗“定心丸”。中美经贸关系近期经历曲折，也给双方带来一些启示。经贸应该继续成为中美关系的压舱石和推进器，而不是绊脚石和冲突点。双方应该算大账，多看合作带来的长远利益，而不应陷入相互报复的恶性循环。双方团队可以继续本着平等、尊重、互惠的原则谈下去，不断压缩问题清单，拉长合作清单。
units.en: President Xi noted that the two teams had an in-depth exchange of views on important economic and trade issues, and reached consensus on solving various issues. They should work out and finalize the follow-up steps as soon as possible, and ensure that the common understandings are effectively upheld and implemented, to inject confidence into the two countries as well as the global economy through solid deliverables. China-U.S. economic and trade relations have experienced ups and downs recently, and this has also given the two sides some insights. The business relationship should continue to serve as the anchor and driving force for China-U.S. relations, not a stumbling block or a point of friction. The two sides should think big and recognize the long-term benefit of cooperation, and must not fall into a vicious cycle of mutual retaliation. The two teams can continue their talks in the spirit of equality, mutual respect and mutual benefit, and continuously shorten the list of problems and lengthen the list of cooperation.

units.zh: 习近平强调，对话比对抗好。中美之间各渠道各层级应该保持沟通，增进了解。两国在打击非法移民和电信诈骗、反洗钱、人工智能、应对传染疾病等领域合作前景良好，对口部门应该加强对话交流，开展互利合作。中美在地区和国际舞台也应该良性互动。当今世界还有很多难题，中国和美国可以共同展现大国担当，携手多办一些有利于两国和世界的大事、实事、好事。
units.en: President Xi stressed that dialogue is better than confrontation. China and the U.S. should maintain communication through various channels and at various levels to enhance mutual understanding. There is good potential for the two countries to work together on combating illegal immigration and telecom fraud, anti-money laundering, artificial intelligence, and responding to infectious diseases. The competent departments should strengthen dialogue and exchanges and carry out mutually beneficial cooperation. China and the U.S. should also engage in positive interactions on regional and international platforms. The world today is confronted with many tough problems. China and the United States can jointly shoulder our responsibility as major countries, and work together to accomplish more great and concrete things for the good of our two countries and the whole world.

units.zh: 明年，中国将担任亚太经合组织东道主，美国将主办二十国集团峰会。双方可以相互支持，争取两场峰会都取得积极成果，为促进世界经济增长、完善全球经济治理作出贡献。
units.en: China will host APEC 2026, and the U.S. the G20 summit next year. The two sides can support each other in making both summits productive to promote world economic growth and improve global economic governance.

units.zh: 特朗普表示，很荣幸同习近平主席会面。中国是伟大国家，习主席是受人尊敬的伟大领导人，也是我多年的好朋友，我们相处非常愉快。美中关系一直很好，将来会更好，希望中国和美国的未来都更加美好。中国是美国最大的伙伴，两国携手可以在世界上做成很多大事，未来美中合作会取得更大成就。中国将举办2026年亚太经合组织领导人非正式会议，美国将举办二十国集团峰会，乐见双方取得成功。
units.en: President Trump said that it is a great honor to meet President Xi. China is a great country. President Xi is a well respected great leader, and has been my good friend for many years. We have always got along well. The United States and China have always had a fantastic relationship, and it will be even better. We will make both China and the U.S. even better. China is the biggest partner of the U.S. Together, our two countries can get many great things done for the world and have many years of success. China will host APEC 2026, and the U.S. will host the G20 summit next year. We expect both to be successful.

units.zh: 两国元首同意加强双方在经贸、能源等领域合作，促进人文交流。
units.en: The two presidents agreed to enhance cooperation in economic, trade, energy and other fields and to encourage more people-to-people exchanges.

units.zh: 两国元首同意保持经常性交往。特朗普期待明年早些时候访华，邀请习近平主席访问美国。
units.en: The two presidents agreed to maintain interactions on a regular basis. President Trump looked forward to visiting China early next year, and invited President Xi to visit the United States.

units.zh: 蔡奇、王毅、何立峰等参加会见。
units.en: Cai Qi, Wang Yi, and He Lifeng, among others, attended the meeting.

files.name: 习近平春节前夕慰问部队(20260211) (1)

units.zh: 习近平春节前夕慰问部队 向全体人民解放军指战员武警部队官兵军队文职人员预备役人员和民兵致以新春祝福
units.en: Xi extends Spring Festival greetings to service personnel

units.zh: 新华社北京2月11日电（记者梅常伟）新春佳节即将来临之际，中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平10日在北京八一大楼以视频方式检查全军战备值班和执行任务情况，亲切慰问有关部队，代表党中央和中央军委，向全体人民解放军指战员、武警部队官兵、军队文职人员、预备役人员和民兵致以诚挚问候和新春祝福。
units.en: BEIJING, Feb. 13 (Xinhua) -- As the Spring Festival draws near, Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee, Chinese president, and chairman of the Central Military Commission (CMC), inspected the armed forces' combat readiness and ongoing operations and extended cordial greetings to relevant troops via video link at the Bayi Building in Beijing on Feb. 10. On behalf of the CPC Central Committee and the CMC, Xi expressed sincere regards and extended Spring Festival greetings to service personnel of the Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) and the People's Armed Police Force, civilian personnel posted in the military, and members of reserve forces and militia.

units.zh: 下午4时许，习近平来到八一大楼，同来自各军兵种和武警部队的9个单位视频通话。陆军某旅2营、海军安徽舰、空军航空兵某旅、火箭军某旅、军事航天部队某部、网络空间部队某部、信息支援部队某中心、联勤保障部队某仓库、武警部队某支队，依次向习主席报告战备值班和执行任务情况。习近平认真听取汇报，同他们亲切交流。看到官兵精神饱满、士气高昂，在各自岗位上扎实练兵备战，习近平给予充分肯定，勉励大家狠抓实战化练兵，用好手中武器装备，提高部队战斗力建设和运用水平。
units.en: At around 4 p.m., Xi arrived at the Bayi Building. He spoke via video link with nine units from different services of the military and the armed police. The officers and soldiers from the units -- the 2nd Battalion of an Army brigade, the Navy's amphibious assault ship Anhui, an Air Force aviation brigade, a Rocket Force brigade, an Aerospace Force unit, a Cyberspace Force unit, a center of the Information Support Force, a depot of the Joint Logistic Support Force and a detachment of the Armed Police Force -- reported to Xi about their combat readiness and ongoing operations in sequence. Xi listened attentively to what they reported and engaged in cordial exchanges with them. He gave full affirmation when he learned that the officers and soldiers, high in spirits and morale, made solid efforts to bolster training and combat readiness in their respective posts. Xi encouraged the officers and soldiers to devote great energy to vigorously strengthening combat-oriented training, make good use of the in-service weaponry and equipment, and enhance the building and operational employment of their combat capabilities.

units.zh: 习近平指出，过去的一年很不寻常、很不平凡。人民军队深入推进政治整训，有效应对各种风险挑战，在反腐败斗争中经受革命性锻造。全军广大官兵特别是基层官兵坚定听党话、跟党走，忠诚履职尽责，聚力攻坚克难，圆满完成各项任务，是完全过得硬、信得过的。
units.en: Describing the past year as highly unusual and extraordinary, Xi said the people's armed forces had advanced in-depth political rectification, effectively addressed various risks and challenges, and undergone a revolutionary tempering in the fight against corruption. Officers and soldiers across the armed forces, especially those at the grassroots level, had been steadfast in following the Party's commands, faithfully fulfilled their duties, pooled strength to overcome challenges, and successfully accomplished all tasks, proving themselves capable and dependable, Xi said.

units.zh: 习近平强调，再过几天就是马年春节了，过节不忘战备是我军光荣传统。全军部队要加强战备值班，保持规定戒备状态，及时有效处置各种可能的突发情况，守护好祖国安宁和人民幸福。同时，要注意搞好工作统筹，把节日期间生活安排好。
units.en: The New Year holiday of the Year of the Horse is just days away, and maintaining combat readiness during holidays is a fine tradition of the PLA, Xi said, asking all military units to strengthen combat readiness, maintain required vigilance, and stand ready to respond to various potential emergencies in a timely and effective manner, so as to safeguard national peace and the well-being of the people. Meanwhile, efforts should be made to ensure overall coordination between work and life during the festival, Xi said.

units.zh: 张升民等参加活动。（完）
units.en: Zhang Shengmin and others were present at the event.  Enditem

files.name: 习近平同党外人士共迎新春(20260211) (1)

units.zh: 习近平同党外人士共迎新春 代表中共中央，向各民主党派、工商联和无党派人士，向统一战线广大成员，致以诚挚问候和美好祝福 王沪宁蔡奇丁薛祥出席
units.en: Xi takes part in Spring Festival gathering with non-CPC members

units.zh: 新华社北京2月11日电 在中华民族传统节日丙午马年春节即将到来之际，中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平11日下午在人民大会堂同各民主党派中央、全国工商联负责人和无党派人士代表欢聚一堂，共迎新春。习近平代表中共中央，向各民主党派、工商联和无党派人士，向统一战线广大成员，致以诚挚问候和美好祝福。
units.en: BEIJING, Feb. 13 (Xinhua) -- As the Spring Festival of the Year of the Horse in the Chinese lunar calendar approaches, Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee, Chinese president and chairman of the Central Military Commission, took part in a gathering on the afternoon of Feb. 11 to greet the upcoming festival with leading officials of the non-CPC political parties' central committees and the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce (ACFIC) and representatives of personages without party affiliation at the Great Hall of the People. On behalf of the CPC Central Committee, Xi extended sincere greetings and best wishes to people from the non-CPC political parties and the ACFIC, personages without party affiliation, and other members of the united front.

units.zh: 中共中央政治局常委、全国政协主席王沪宁，中共中央政治局常委、中央办公厅主任蔡奇，中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥出席。
units.en: The gathering was also attended by Wang Huning, chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, Cai Qi, director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, and Ding Xuexiang, vice premier of the State Council. They are all members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee.

units.zh: 民革中央主席郑建邦、民盟中央主席丁仲礼、民建中央常务副主席秦博勇、民进中央主席蔡达峰、农工党中央主席何维、致公党中央主席蒋作君、九三学社中央主席武维华、台盟中央主席苏辉、全国工商联主席高云龙和无党派人士代表周忠和、王梅祥等应邀出席。应邀出席的还有全国政协副主席何厚铧、梁振英，已退出领导岗位的各民主党派中央、全国工商联原主席、第一副主席和常务副主席。
units.en: Those who attended the gathering at invitation included Zheng Jianbang, chairperson of the Central Committee of the Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang; Ding Zhongli, chairperson of the Central Committee of the China Democratic League; Qin Boyong, executive vice-chairperson of the Central Committee of the China National Democratic Construction Association; Cai Dafeng, chairperson of the Central Committee of the China Association for Promoting Democracy; He Wei, chairperson of the Central Committee of the Chinese Peasants and Workers Democratic Party; Jiang Zuojun, chairperson of the Central Committee of the China Zhi Gong Party; Wu Weihua, chairperson of the Central Committee of the Jiusan Society; Su Hui, chairperson of the Central Committee of the Taiwan Democratic Self-Government League; Gao Yunlong, chairperson of the ACFIC; and representatives of personages without party affiliation Zhou Zhonghe and Wang Meixiang, among others. Also present at invitation were Ho Hau Wah and Leung Chun-ying, vice-chairpersons of the CPPCC National Committee, as well as former chairpersons, first vice-chairpersons and executive vice-chairpersons of the central committees of the non-CPC political parties and the ACFIC who have retired from leading posts.

units.zh: 何维代表各民主党派中央、全国工商联和无党派人士致辞。他表示，2025年，以习近平同志为核心的中共中央团结带领全党全国各族人民在风高浪急中砥砺前行，在攻坚克难中铸就辉煌，圆满完成“十四五”目标任务，推动党和国家事业取得新的重大成就。新的一年，各民主党派、工商联和无党派人士要更加紧密团结在以习近平同志为核心的中共中央周围，聚焦“十五五”规划制定实施，积极建言资政，努力为开创中国式现代化建设新局面作贡献。
units.en: He Wei delivered a speech on behalf of the central committees of the non-CPC political parties, the ACFIC and personages without party affiliation. He stated that in 2025, under the leadership of the CPC Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core, the entire Party and the Chinese people of all ethnic groups forged ahead amid high winds and rough seas, overcame difficulties and challenges, and achieved brilliant results, successfully accomplishing the goals and tasks of the 14th Five-Year Plan, and securing significant new achievements in the cause of the Party and the country. In the new year, the non-CPC political parties, the ACFIC and personages without Party affiliation will rally more closely around the CPC Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core, focus on the formulation and implementation of the 15th Five-Year Plan, actively offer suggestions and advice for governance, and strive to make contributions to opening up new horizons for Chinese modernization.

units.zh: 在听取何维致辞后，习近平发表重要讲话。他强调，2025年是很不平凡的一年。面对国内外形势深刻复杂变化，中共中央团结带领全党全国各族人民迎难而上、奋力拼搏，顺利完成经济社会发展主要目标任务。召开中共二十届四中全会，擘画“十五五”发展蓝图。隆重纪念中国人民抗日战争暨世界反法西斯战争胜利80周年，设立台湾光复纪念日，庆祝西藏自治区成立60周年、新疆维吾尔自治区成立70周年。坚定不移贯彻新发展理念、推动高质量发展，进一步全面深化改革，我国经济顶压前行、向新向优发展。持续加强民生保障，扎实推进社会主义民主法治建设、文化建设、生态文明建设、国防和军队建设，保持社会大局稳定。提出全球治理倡议，积极推动构建人类命运共同体。扎实开展深入贯彻中央八项规定精神学习教育，作风建设和反腐败斗争取得显著成效。历经5年不懈奋斗，“十四五”圆满收官，我国经济实力、科技实力、国防实力、综合国力跃上新台阶，中国式现代化迈出新的坚实步伐。这些成绩来之不易，是中国共产党坚强领导的结果，是包括各民主党派、工商联和无党派人士在内的全国各族人民共同奋斗的结果。
units.en: Xi delivered an important address after listening to He Wei's speech. He stressed that 2025 was a truly extraordinary year. Facing profound and complex changes in the domestic and international situation, the CPC Central Committee united and led the entire Party and people of all ethnic groups across the country to meet challenges head-on and strive hard, successfully accomplishing the main goals and tasks for economic and social development. We convened the fourth plenary session of the 20th CPC Central Committee, mapping out the blueprint for the 15th Five-Year Plan (2026-2030). We solemnly held activities to mark the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War and established the Commemoration Day of Taiwan's Restoration; and celebrated the 60th anniversary of the founding of the Xizang Autonomous Region and the 70th anniversary of the founding of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region. We made further efforts to implement the new development philosophy, promote high-quality development, and deepen reform in all respects. As a result, China's economy has maintained robust growth against pressures, achieving new and higher-quality progress. We made sustained efforts to improve people's wellbeing, made solid progress in developing socialist democracy and the rule of law, advancing cultural development, improving ecological conservation, and modernizing national defense and the armed forces, and maintained social stability. We put forward the Global Governance Initiative to promote the building of a community with a shared future for humanity. We made solid efforts to implement the central Party leadership's eight-point decision on improving Party conduct, achieving remarkable progress in improving Party conduct and fighting against corruption. After five years of unremitting efforts, the 14th Five-Year Plan concluded successfully. As a result, our country's strength in economy, science and technology, national defense and in all sectors has reached new highs, and solid new strides have been made in advancing Chinese modernization. Such achievements have not come easily, and they are the result of the strong leadership of the CPC and the hard work and joint efforts of Chinese people from all ethnic groups, including the non-CPC political parties, the ACFIC and personages without party affiliation.

units.zh: 习近平指出，过去一年，多党合作事业取得丰硕成果。各民主党派中央和无党派人士认真贯彻落实中共中央决策部署，扎实开展“学规定、强作风、树形象”主题教育，聚焦经济社会发展重点难点问题积极建言献策，为党和国家事业发展作出了新贡献。全国工商联为促进“两个健康”做了大量工作。他代表中共中央，向大家表示衷心感谢！
units.en: Xi noted that over the past year, multiparty cooperation saw great achievements. The central committees of non-CPC political parties and personages without party affiliation conscientiously implemented the decisions and plans of the CPC Central Committee, took solid steps to launch education programs to study the central CPC leadership's eight-point decision on improving Party conduct, and improved conduct and fostered a positive image. Focusing on key problems in economic and social development, they actively submitted advice and suggestions, making new contributions to the cause of the Party and the country. The ACFIC did a lot of work to facilitate the healthy development of the non-public sector and those working in it. On behalf of the CPC Central Committee, Xi extended sincere gratitude to all of them.

units.zh: 习近平强调，2026年是“十五五”开局之年，希望各民主党派、工商联和无党派人士紧紧围绕贯彻落实中共中央决策部署积极履职尽责，努力展现新作为。一是强化政治引领，凝聚团结奋斗力量。要坚持不懈用新时代中国特色社会主义思想凝心铸魂，深入学习贯彻中共二十届四中全会精神，始终同中国共产党想在一起、站在一起、干在一起。全国工商联要引导民营经济人士坚定发展信心，走高质量发展之路。二是围绕中心、服务大局，努力为“十五五”发展作贡献。要加强调查研究，为中共中央科学决策提供更多务实管用的建议。认真组织开展黄河流域生态保护和高质量发展民主监督工作。三是切实加强自身建设，更好展现中国特色社会主义参政党和参政力量新风貌。要加强领导班子建设，注重成员发展质量，从严正风肃纪，巩固发展良好政治生态。要深化政治交接，确保多党合作事业始终保持旺盛活力。
units.en: Xi stressed that 2026 marks the beginning of the 15th Five-Year Plan period. He expressed the hope that the non-CPC political parties, the ACFIC and personages without party affiliation will earnestly perform duties in implementing the decisions and plans of the CPC Central Committee and strive to make new progress. First, political guidance should be strengthened to forge unity for struggle. They should consistently study the Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era in forging their political awareness, thoroughly study and act on the guiding principles of the fourth plenary session of the 20th CPC Central Committee, and always close ranks with the CPC in thinking, stance and action. The ACFIC should guide those in private-sector to strengthen their confidence in development and pursue a path of high-quality development. Second, they should do their work to serve the needs of the overall national agenda, with the cause of the Party and country as the focus, contributing as much as possible to development during the 15th Five-Year Plan period. They should conduct more fact-finding missions to provide practical and effective recommendations for the CPC Central Committee's scientific decision-making. They should conscientiously carry out democratic oversight over the ecological conservation in the Yellow River Basin and the high-quality development. Third, they should strengthen their own improvement to present a fresh look as political parties and forces participating in state governance under socialism with Chinese characteristics. They should strengthen the building of their leadership teams, attach importance to the quality of their members, and rigorously improve their conduct and enforce discipline, so as to consolidate and develop a sound political environment. They should make sure leadership transition is politically sound to ensure that the multi-party cooperation retains its lasting vitality.

units.zh: 李干杰，各民主党派中央、全国工商联有关负责人，中央有关部门负责同志参加活动。（完）
units.en: Also present at the gathering were Li Ganjie, and leading members of the central committees of the non-CPC political parties and the ACFIC, as well as officials from relevant departments of the CPC Central Committee.  Enditem

files.name: 中共中央政治局召开会议审议报告-20260130 (1)

units.zh: 中共中央政治局召开会议 审议《中央政治局常委会听取和研究全国人大常委会、国务院、全国政协、最高人民法院、最高人民检察院党组工作汇报和中央书记处工作报告的综合情况报告》 中共中央总书记习近平主持会议
units.en: CPC leadership holds meeting to review report on work of state institutions, secretariat of Party Central Committee

units.zh: 新华社北京1月30日电 中共中央政治局1月30日召开会议，审议《中央政治局常委会听取和研究全国人大常委会、国务院、全国政协、最高人民法院、最高人民检察院党组工作汇报和中央书记处工作报告的综合情况报告》。中共中央总书记习近平主持会议。
units.en: BEIJING, Jan. 31 (Xinhua) -- The Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee held a meeting on Jan. 30 to review a report from the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau on its hearing and discussion of work reports from the leading Party members groups of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, the State Council, the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate, as well as the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee. Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, presided over the meeting.

units.zh: 会议对全国人大常委会、国务院、全国政协、最高人民法院、最高人民检察院党组和中央书记处2025年的工作给予充分肯定，同意其2026年工作安排。会议认为，过去一年，5家党组坚持以习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想为指导，坚定维护党中央权威和集中统一领导，认真贯彻落实党的二十大和二十届历次全会精神，紧紧围绕党和国家工作大局发挥职能作用，切实加强党组自身建设，为全年主要目标任务顺利完成、“十四五”圆满收官作出积极贡献。中央书记处在中央政治局、中央政治局常委会领导下，认真贯彻党中央决策部署，积极履职尽责，在完成党中央交办任务、加强党内法规制度建设、指导推动群团工作、整治形式主义为基层减负等方面做了大量工作。
units.en: The meeting spoke highly of the work of the leading Party members groups of the top legislature, central government, top political advisory body, supreme court, and supreme procuratorate, as well as the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee in 2025, and approved their work arrangements for 2026. It was noted at the meeting that over the past year, the five leading Party members groups followed the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, resolutely upheld the authority of the CPC Central Committee and its centralized, unified leadership, earnestly implemented the guiding principles of the 20th CPC National Congress and all plenary sessions of the 20th CPC Central Committee, performed their duties centering on the overall plan of the Party and the state, effectively strengthened their own development, and made positive contributions to the successful completion of the main goals and tasks for 2025 and the successful conclusion of the 14th Five-Year Plan. Under the leadership of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and its Standing Committee, the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee earnestly implemented the decisions and plans of the CPC Central Committee, actively performed its duties and fulfilled its responsibilities, and did a great deal of work in areas such as completing tasks assigned by the CPC Central Committee, strengthening the development of intra-Party regulations and institutions, guiding and promoting the work of mass organizations, and rectifying pointless formalities to ease unnecessary workload at the primary level.

units.zh: 会议强调，今年是中国共产党成立105周年，是“十五五”开局之年。5家党组要以习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想为指导，坚持党中央集中统一领导，不折不扣把党的二十届四中全会精神和党中央关于今年工作的决策部署落到实处。坚持稳中求进工作总基调，锚定“十五五”时期经济社会发展重大战略任务，努力实现良好开局。加强党组自身建设，认真履行全面从严治党主体责任，带头树立和践行正确政绩观。中央书记处要围绕中央政治局、中央政治局常委会部署要求，立足职责抓好重点任务落实，高质量完成党中央交办的各项任务。
units.en: It was stressed at the meeting that this year marks the 105th anniversary of the founding of the CPC and is the first year of the 15th Five-Year Plan period (2026-2030). The five leading Party members groups must follow the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, uphold the centralized, unified leadership of the CPC Central Committee, and implement to the letter the guiding principles of the fourth plenary session of the 20th CPC Central Committee and the Party Central Committee's major decisions and plans concerning the work this year. They must adhere to the general principle of pursuing progress while ensuring stability, and stick to the major strategic tasks for the economic and social development during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, making sure the plan is off to a good start. They must strengthen their own development, fulfill their principal responsibility for exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance, and take the lead in establishing a correct understanding of what it means to perform well and acting accordingly. The Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee must, in accordance with the decisions and requirements of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and its Standing Committee, perform its duties well, ensuring the effective implementation of key tasks, and completing with high quality all assignments entrusted to it by the Party Central Committee.

units.zh: 会议还研究了其他事项。（完）
units.en: Other matters were also discussed at the meeting.  Enditem

files.name: 征求对经济工作的意见和建议中共中央召开党外人士座谈会20251208 (1)

units.zh: 征求对经济工作的意见和建议 中共中央召开党外人士座谈会 习近平主持并发表重要讲话 李强通报有关情况 蔡奇丁薛祥出席
units.en: CPC Central Committee solicits opinions and suggestions on economic work from non-CPC personages

units.zh: 新华社北京12月8日电 12月3日，中共中央在中南海召开党外人士座谈会，就今年经济形势和明年经济工作听取各民主党派中央、全国工商联负责人和无党派人士代表的意见建议。中共中央总书记习近平主持座谈会并发表重要讲话强调，我国经济长期向好的支撑条件和基本趋势没有改变，要坚定信心、用好优势、应对挑战，不断巩固拓展经济稳中向好势头，实现“十五五”良好开局。
units.en: BEIJING, Dec. 10 (Xinhua) -- On Dec. 3, the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee convened a symposium at Zhongnanhai in Beijing to solicit opinions and suggestions on the country's economic performance this year and economic work for the next year from the central committees of eight non-CPC parties, chairperson of the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce (ACFIC), as well as prominent figures without party affiliation. Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, presided over the symposium and delivered an important speech. He emphasized that the underlying conditions and fundamental trends sustaining China's long-term economic growth remain unchanged. He noted the need to strengthen confidence, leverage the strengths, rise to challenges, continuously consolidate and expand the positive momentum of steady economic growth, and get the 15th Five-Year Plan period (2026-2030) off to a good start.

units.zh: 中共中央政治局常委李强、蔡奇、丁薛祥出席座谈会。李强受中共中央委托通报了今年经济工作有关情况，介绍了关于明年经济工作有关考虑。
units.en: Li Qiang, Cai Qi and Ding Xuexiang, who are members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, attended the symposium. Entrusted by the CPC Central Committee, Li Qiang briefed the participants on the performance of this year's economic work and shared considerations regarding economic work for the coming year.

units.zh: 座谈会上，民革中央主席郑建邦、民盟中央主席丁仲礼、民建中央副主席孙东生、民进中央主席蔡达峰、农工党中央主席何维、致公党中央主席蒋作君、九三学社中央主席武维华、台盟中央主席苏辉、全国工商联主席高云龙、无党派人士代表高鸿钧先后发言。他们完全赞同中共中央对当前经济形势的分析判断和明年经济工作的谋划考虑，并就优化产业布局、增加优质供给、深化教育科技人才制度改革、建设数据要素全国统一大市场、扩大内需、拓展高水平对外开放、增进人民健康福祉、推进高质量就业、提升文化软实力等提出意见建议。
units.en: At the symposium, those who delivered remarks included Zheng Jianbang, chairman of the Central Committee of the Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang; Ding Zhongli, chairman of the Central Committee of the China Democratic League; Sun Dongsheng, vice chairman of the Central Committee of the China National Democratic Construction Association; Cai Dafeng, chairman of the Central Committee of the China Association for Promoting Democracy; He Wei, chairman of the Central Committee of the Chinese Peasants and Workers Democratic Party; Jiang Zuojun, chairman of the Central Committee of the China Zhi Gong Party; Wu Weihua, chairman of the Central Committee of the Jiusan Society; Su Hui, chairperson of the Central Committee of the Taiwan Democratic Self-Government League; Gao Yunlong, chairman of the ACFIC; and Gao Hongjun, a representative of personages without party affiliation. They fully endorsed the CPC Central Committee's analysis and judgment of the current economic situation and its planning for next year's economic work. They put forward opinions and suggestions on optimizing industrial layout, increasing high-quality supply, deepening reforms of systems concerning education, science and technology as well as talent, building a unified national market for data factors, expanding domestic demand, advancing high-standard opening up, enhancing people's health and well-being, promoting high-quality employment, and strengthening cultural soft power.

units.zh: 在认真听取大家发言后，习近平发表重要讲话。他表示，大家充分肯定了今年经济工作取得的成绩，就做好明年经济工作提出了意见建议，我们将认真研究采纳。
units.en: After earnestly listening to their remarks, Xi delivered an important speech. He stated that the participants had fully affirmed the achievements made in this year's economic work and offered opinions and suggestions for next year's economic work, which the CPC Central Committee would carefully study and adopt.

units.zh: 习近平指出，今年是很不平凡的一年，中共中央团结带领全党全国各族人民迎难而上、奋力拼搏，统筹国内国际两个大局，实施更加积极有为的宏观政策，经济社会发展主要目标将顺利完成。过去5年，我们有效应对各种冲击挑战，推动党和国家事业取得新的重大成就，“十四五”即将圆满收官，我国经济实力、科技实力、综合国力跃上新台阶。
units.en: Xi pointed out that in 2025, a truly extraordinary year, the CPC Central Committee united and led the entire Party and people of all ethnic groups to meet challenges head-on and strive forward. By keeping in mind both domestic and international imperatives and implementing more proactive and impactful macro policies, we will successfully fulfill the main economic and social development targets. Over the past five years, we have effectively dealt with various challenges, secured new major achievements in the cause of the Party and the country. With the 14th Five-Year Plan period (2021-2025) successfully concluding, China has ascended to new heights in economic strength, scientific and technological capabilities, and composite national power.

units.zh: 习近平指出，今年以来，各民主党派中央、全国工商联和无党派人士紧扣中共中央决策部署，积极开展科技创新和产业创新融合发展、全方位扩大国内需求等方面调研，做好长江生态环境保护民主监督，围绕经济社会发展中一些重点难点问题及时建言献策，为中共中央科学决策提供了重要参考。习近平代表中共中央向大家表示感谢。
units.en: Xi also noted that throughout 2025, central committees of non-CPC political parties, the ACFIC, and prominent figures without party affiliation, having aligned closely with decisions and policies of the CPC Central Committee, conducted fact-finding missions on initiatives such as integrated development of technological and industrial innovation and expansion of multi-dimensional domestic demand, did a good job in democratic oversight over eco-environmental protection along the Yangtze River, and provided timely proposals and suggestions on addressing pivotal issues concerning social and economic development. All these served as important reference for informed decision-making by the CPC Central Committee. On behalf of the CPC Central Committee, Xi extended sincere appreciation to all present at the meeting.

units.zh: 习近平强调，做好明年经济工作，要以新时代中国特色社会主义思想为指导，深入贯彻党的二十大和二十届历次全会精神，完整准确全面贯彻新发展理念，加快构建新发展格局，着力推动高质量发展，坚持稳中求进工作总基调，更好统筹国内经济工作和国际经贸斗争，更好统筹发展和安全，实施更加积极有为的宏观政策，增强政策前瞻性针对性协同性，持续扩大内需、优化供给，做优增量、盘活存量，因地制宜发展新质生产力，纵深推进全国统一大市场建设，持续防范化解重点领域风险，着力稳就业、稳企业、稳市场、稳预期，推动经济实现质的有效提升和量的合理增长，保持社会和谐稳定。
units.en: Xi stressed that to do a good job in economic work next year, it is imperative to follow the guidance of the Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, fully implement the guiding principles of the 20th CPC National Congress and all plenary sessions of the 20th CPC Central Committee, fully and faithfully implement the new development philosophy, move faster to forge a new development paradigm, and focus on promoting high-quality development. It is also essential to adhere to the general principle of pursuing progress while ensuring stability, better coordinate domestic economic work with struggles in the international economic and trade arena, better secure both development and security, implement more proactive and impactful macro policies, and formulate more far-sighted, more targeted and better-coordinated policies. Xi emphasized the need to continuously expand domestic demand, optimize supply, promote new growth drivers and revitalize existing ones, develop new quality productive forces in accordance with local conditions, and further advance the building of a unified national market. It is equally important to prevent and defuse risks in key areas, focus on securing the steady development of employment, enterprises, markets and expectations, promote high-quality economic growth while achieving an appropriate increase in economic output, and ensure that the society is harmonious and stable.

units.zh: 习近平对各民主党派、全国工商联和无党派人士提出3点希望。一是深入学习领会中共二十届四中全会精神。把中共中央的战略部署领会准、理解透，始终同中国共产党想在一起、站在一起、干在一起。二是积极踊跃为制定实施“十五五”规划献计出力。围绕建设现代化产业体系、因地制宜发展新质生产力、建设强大国内市场等深入开展调研，提出有价值、有分量的意见建议。三是凝心聚力推动经济稳定向好。协助党和政府做好政策宣传、解疑释惑、凝聚共识的工作，引导广大成员和所联系群众坚定信心、振奋精神，营造良好发展氛围。
units.en: Xi put forward three hopes for the non-CPC political parties, the ACFIC, and prominent figures without party affiliation. First, they should thoroughly study and fully understand the guiding principles of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee, accurately grasp and fully comprehend the strategic plans of the CPC Central Committee, and always think, stand, and act along with the CPC. Second, they should take active part in contributing ideas and efforts to the formulation and implementation of the 15th Five-Year Plan. In this regard, they are expected to conduct in-depth fact-finding missions on issues such as building a modern industrial system, developing new quality productive forces in light of local conditions, and building a strong domestic market, so as to put forward valuable and weighty opinions and suggestions. Third, they should close ranks to help sustain the momentum of steady economic growth. They are expected to assist the CPC and the government in communicating policies, dispelling doubts and misgivings, and building consensus, and to guide their members and the groups they are in contact with in strengthening confidence and boosting morale, thus fostering a sound atmosphere for development.

units.zh: 刘国中、李干杰、何立峰、张国清、吴政隆，中共中央、国务院有关部门负责人出席座谈会。
units.en: Liu Guozhong, Li Ganjie, He Lifeng, Zhang Guoqing, Wu Zhenglong, and leading officials of relevant departments of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council attended the meeting.

units.zh: 出席座谈会的党外人士还有邵鸿、何报翔、王光谦、朱永新、杨震和张恩迪、方光华、杜莹芬等。（完）
units.en: Non-CPC prominent figures who also attended the meeting included Shao Hong, He Baoxiang, Wang Guangqian, Zhu Yongxin, Yang Zhen, Zhang Endi, Fang Guanghua and Du Yingfen.  Enditem

files.name: 中共中央政治局召开会议分析研究2026年经济工作-20251208 (3)

units.zh: 中共中央政治局召开会议  分析研究2026年经济工作  审议《中国共产党领导全面依法治国工作条例》 中共中央总书记习近平主持会议
units.en: CPC leadership holds meeting on 2026 economic work, regulations on law-based governance

units.zh: 新华社北京12月8日电 中共中央政治局12月8日召开会议，分析研究2026年经济工作，审议《中国共产党领导全面依法治国工作条例》。中共中央总书记习近平主持会议。
units.en: BEIJING, Dec. 9 (Xinhua) -- The Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee held a meeting on December 8 to analyze and study the economic work for 2026 and review regulations on the CPC's leadership over law-based governance in all respects. Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, presided over the meeting.

units.zh: 会议认为，今年是中国式现代化进程中具有重要意义的一年，以习近平同志为核心的党中央团结带领全党全国各族人民迎难而上、奋力拼搏，统筹国内国际两个大局，实施更加积极有为的宏观政策，经济社会发展主要目标将顺利实现。我国经济运行总体平稳、稳中有进，新质生产力稳步发展，改革开放迈出新步伐，重点领域风险化解取得积极进展，民生保障更加有力，社会大局保持稳定。过去5年，我们有效应对各种冲击挑战，我国经济、科技、国防等硬实力和文化、制度、外交等软实力明显提升，“十四五”即将圆满收官，第二个百年奋斗目标新征程实现良好开局。
units.en: It was noted at the meeting that this year is of great significance in advancing Chinese modernization. With Comrade Xi Jinping at its core, the CPC Central Committee has united and led the whole Party and the people of all ethnic groups in meeting challenges head-on and forging ahead. By keeping in mind both domestic and international imperatives and implementing more proactive and impactful macro policies, China is set to smoothly fulfill the main goals for this year's economic and social development. The country's economy has maintained overall stability while making steady progress, with new quality productive forces advancing steadily. New strides have been taken in reform and opening up, and progress has been achieved in defusing risks in key areas, with people's well-being better safeguarded and social stability ensured. Over the past five years, China has effectively dealt with various challenges; and has significantly enhanced its hard power in economy, science and technology, national defense and other areas, as well as its soft power in culture, institutions, diplomacy and other aspects. The 14th Five-Year Plan period (2021-2025) is about to conclude successfully, and the new journey toward the Second Centenary Goal is off to a good start.

units.zh: 会议强调，做好明年经济工作，要以习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想为指导，深入贯彻党的二十大和二十届历次全会精神，完整准确全面贯彻新发展理念，加快构建新发展格局，着力推动高质量发展，坚持稳中求进工作总基调，更好统筹国内经济工作和国际经贸斗争，更好统筹发展和安全，实施更加积极有为的宏观政策，增强政策前瞻性针对性协同性，持续扩大内需、优化供给，做优增量、盘活存量，因地制宜发展新质生产力，纵深推进全国统一大市场建设，持续防范化解重点领域风险，着力稳就业、稳企业、稳市场、稳预期，推动经济实现质的有效提升和量的合理增长，保持社会和谐稳定，实现“十五五”良好开局。
units.en: It was emphasized at the meeting that, to do a good job in economic work next year, we must follow the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era; thoroughly implement the guiding principles of the 20th CPC National Congress and all plenary sessions of the 20th CPC Central Committee; fully and faithfully apply the new development philosophy; move faster to forge a new development paradigm; and focus on promoting high-quality development. We must adhere to the general principle of pursuing progress while ensuring stability, better coordinate domestic economic work with struggles in the international economic and trade arena, and ensure both development and security. We must implement more proactive and impactful macroeconomic policies; formulate more far-sighted, more targeted and better-coordinated policies; continuously expand domestic demand and optimize supply; promote new growth drivers and revitalize existing ones; and develop new quality productive forces according to local conditions. We will make further efforts to develop a unified national market and continuously prevent and defuse risks in key areas. It is imperative to secure steady development of employment, businesses, markets and expectations, to effectively pursue higher-quality economic growth and appropriately increase economic output while maintaining social harmony and stability, getting the 15th Five-Year Plan (2026-2030) off to a good start.

units.zh: 会议指出，明年经济工作要坚持稳中求进、提质增效，继续实施更加积极的财政政策和适度宽松的货币政策，发挥存量政策和增量政策集成效应，加大逆周期和跨周期调节力度，切实提升宏观经济治理效能。要坚持内需主导，建设强大国内市场；坚持创新驱动，加紧培育壮大新动能；坚持改革攻坚，增强高质量发展动力活力；坚持对外开放，推动多领域合作共赢；坚持协调发展，促进城乡融合和区域联动；坚持“双碳”引领，推动全面绿色转型；坚持民生为大，努力为人民群众多办实事；坚持守牢底线，积极稳妥化解重点领域风险。
units.en: It was pointed out at the meeting that as far as the next year's economic work is concerned, we must adhere to the principle of pursuing progress while ensuring stability, and boost both quality and performance. We will continue implementing a more proactive fiscal policy and an appropriately accommodative monetary policy, allow full play to the synergies of both existing and newly adopted policies, and bolster counter- and cross-cyclical adjustments so as to tangibly improve the effectiveness of macroeconomic governance. Domestic demand will remain as a focus in building a robust domestic market. It will be essential to enhance innovation-driven development to accelerate the cultivation of new growth drivers. The need was emphasized to deepen reform to boost the momentum and vitality of high-quality development. It will be important to expand high-level opening up for win-win cooperation across multiple sectors. Coordinated development should be advanced for promoting urban and rural integration and integrated regional development. With carbon emissions peaking and carbon neutrality as the goals, efforts will be made to promote a comprehensive green transformation. Prioritizing people's livelihoods, practical measures will be taken to get things done for the people. Red line must never be crossed when it comes to safety, and active and prudent efforts must be maintained to defuse risks in key areas.

units.zh: 会议强调，要加强党的领导特别是党中央集中统一领导。树立和践行正确政绩观，因地制宜做好经济工作，实现高质量、可持续的发展。编制好国家和地方“十五五”规划及专项规划。做好岁末年初重要民生商品保供工作，关心困难群众生产生活，解决好拖欠企业账款和农民工工资问题，兜牢民生底线。以时时放心不下的责任感抓好安全生产，坚决防范遏制重特大事故发生。
units.en: The need was stressed at the meeting to strengthen the Party's leadership, especially the centralized, unified leadership of the CPC Central Committee. The meeting also called for a correct understanding of what it means to perform well, doing a good job in economic work according to local conditions, and pursuing high-quality and sustainable development. It also urged efforts to well formulate the 15th Five-Year plans at national and local levels and relevant special plans. A good job must be done to ensure adequate supply of major goods related to people's basic needs at the turn of the year, take care of the work and lives of people in need, resolve the issue of payments in arrears to businesses and wages owed to rural migrant workers, and ensure that basic living standards are secured for those in need. It called for efforts on the part of those in charge to ensure workplace safety with a strong sense of responsibility, so as to forestall and defuse risks of major and serious accidents.

units.zh: 会议指出，制定《中国共产党领导全面依法治国工作条例》，对于进一步提升党领导全面依法治国的科学化、制度化、规范化水平，建设更加完善的中国特色社会主义法治体系，建设更高水平的社会主义法治国家，具有重要意义。
units.en: It was noted at the meeting that formulating the regulations on the CPC's leadership over law-based governance in all respects is of great significance for boosting sound, institutionalized and standardized Party leadership in this regard, for advancing the socialist rule of law with Chinese characteristics and building a socialist country under the rule of law at a higher level.

units.zh: 会议强调，要坚持和加强党的领导，把党领导立法、保证执法、支持司法、带头守法落到实处，提高依法治国、依法执政水平。全面贯彻习近平法治思想，牢牢把握全面依法治国正确政治方向，坚定法治自信，坚定不移走中国特色社会主义法治道路。促使各级领导干部增强尊崇法治、敬畏法律意识，协同推进科学立法、严格执法、公正司法、全民守法，全面推进国家各方面工作法治化，为以中国式现代化全面推进强国建设、民族复兴伟业提供有力法治保障。（完）
units.en: The need was emphasized at the meeting to uphold and strengthen the Party's leadership, and to ensure the Party's role in leading legislation, securing law enforcement, supporting administration of justice, and setting a good example in observing the law, so as to enhance the Party's capacity to govern the country and exercise state power in accordance with the law. It is imperative to apply Xi Jinping Thought on Rule of Law in all respects, firmly follow the correct political direction for law-based governance, strengthen confidence in the rule of law, and unswervingly practice the socialist rule of law with Chinese characteristics. Efforts were called for to boost the awareness of leading officials at all levels about the rule of law and their respect for the law. Coordinated efforts were urged to advance sound legislation, strict law enforcement, impartial administration of justice, and observance of the law by all. Comprehensive efforts will be made to promote law-based governance in all aspects of the government work, so as to make the rule of law a strong guarantee for building China into a great country and advancing national rejuvenation on all fronts through Chinese modernization.  Enditem

files.name: 习近平强调高标准建设海南自由贸易港 (1)

units.zh: 习近平在听取海南自由贸易港建设工作汇报时强调 认真学习贯彻党的二十届四中全会精神 高标准建设海南自由贸易港 蔡奇出席汇报会
units.en: Xi stresses building Hainan Free Trade Port with high standards

units.zh: 新华社三亚11月6日电 中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平在听取海南自由贸易港建设工作汇报时强调，建设海南自由贸易港，是党中央着眼新时代全面深化改革开放作出的重大决策。要认真学习贯彻党的二十届四中全会精神，在党中央集中统一领导下，各级各有关方面密切协作、主动作为，通过持续努力，全面实现海南自由贸易港建设目标。
units.en: SANYA, Nov. 8 (Xinhua) -- President Xi Jinping, who is also general secretary of the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee and chairman of the Central Military Commission, stressed, when hearing a work report on the building of Hainan Free Trade Port (FTP), that building the Hainan FTP is a major policy made by the CPC Central Committee to comprehensively deepen reform and opening up in the new era. He stressed the need to study and implement the guiding principles of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee. Under the centralized and unified leadership of the CPC Central Committee, all relevant parties at all levels should closely coordinate and take the initiative to fully achieve the goals of building the Hainan FTP through continuous efforts.

units.zh: 11月6日上午，习近平在海南省三亚市听取海南自由贸易港建设工作汇报。国家发展改革委主任郑栅洁、海南省委书记冯飞作了汇报。
units.en: On the morning of Nov. 6, Xi listened to the work report on the development of the Hainan FTP in Sanya, Hainan Province. Zheng Shanjie, director of the National Development and Reform Commission, and Feng Fei, secretary of the CPC Hainan Provincial Committee, presented the report.

units.zh: 听取汇报后，习近平发表重要讲话。他指出，党中央决定，今年12月18日海南自由贸易港正式启动全岛封关，这是我国坚定不移扩大高水平对外开放、推动建设开放型世界经济的标志性举措。各级各有关方面要精心准备，确保平稳有序。
units.en: After listening to the report, Xi delivered an important speech. He pointed out that, following the decision of the CPC Central Committee, the Hainan FTP will officially commence its island-wide special customs operations on Dec. 18 this year. He described this as a landmark move of the country to unwaveringly expand high-standard opening up and promote the development of an open world economy. All relevant departments at all levels must make meticulous preparations to ensure a smooth and orderly transition, Xi said.

units.zh: 习近平强调，建设海南自由贸易港的战略目标，就是要把海南自由贸易港打造成为引领我国新时代对外开放的重要门户。要锚定这个战略目标不动摇，全面落实海南自由贸易港建设总体方案，深入实施海南自由贸易港法，解放思想、改革创新，分步骤、分阶段构建与高水平自由贸易港相适应的政策制度体系。要稳步扩大制度型开放，进一步提高贸易投资自由化便利化水平。深入推进商品和要素流动型开放，更好促进生产要素跨境流动。构建更加开放的人才机制，为自由贸易港建设提供有力人才支撑。深化行政体制改革，优化政务服务，着力打造市场化法治化国际化一流营商环境。
units.en: Xi stressed that the strategic goal of building the Hainan FTP is to develop it into a key gateway driving China's opening up in the new era. It is imperative to steadfastly pursue this strategic goal, fully carry out the master plan for the building of the Hainan FTP, thoroughly enforce the Hainan Free Trade Port Law, emancipate the mind, pursue reform and innovation, and build a framework of policies and institutions that aligns with a high-level FTP in a phased and step-by-step manner. Efforts should be made to steadily expand institutional opening up, and take further steps to facilitate trade and investment liberalization. The province was urged to make further progress in opening up in terms of the flows of goods and production factors, and better facilitate cross-border flows of production factors. Xi called on the province to create a more open talent mechanism to provide solid backing with a high-caliber talent pool for building the FTP. Work should be done to deepen the reform of administrative systems, improve government services, and strive to create a first-rate business environment that is market-oriented, law-based and internationalized.

units.zh: 习近平指出，高标准建设海南自由贸易港，主要目的是促进海南高质量发展，助力全国构建新发展格局。要结合实际科学编制“十五五”规划，紧紧围绕建设“三区一中心”的战略定位，全面提高海南经济社会发展水平。着力打造具有海南特色和优势的现代化产业体系，推动主导产业优化升级，促进科技创新和产业创新深度融合，努力在发展新质生产力上取得新突破。加强同粤港澳大湾区联动发展，深化同京津冀、长三角、长江经济带等区域合作，深度融入共建“一带一路”，在推进高水平对外开放中发挥牵引作用。生态是海南一大优势，要守护好这份家底，坚持陆海统筹，持续抓好突出环境问题整治，高质量建设国家生态文明试验区。加强普惠性、基础性、兜底性民生建设，解决好人民群众急难愁盼问题，扎实推进共同富裕。
units.en: Xi pointed out that building the Hainan FTP with high standards is meant to promote high-quality development in Hainan and boost national efforts to create a new development paradigm. He called on Hainan to scientifically formulate its 15th Five-Year Plan (2026-2030) based on practical conditions, and focus closely on its strategic positioning as a pilot zone for the comprehensive deepening of reform and opening up, a national pilot zone for ecological conservation, an international tourism and consumption destination, and a service zone for major national strategies, thereby comprehensively boosting the province's economic and social development. Efforts should be made to develop a modernized industrial system that leverages Hainan's characteristics and strengths, promote the upgrading of leading industries, and advance the deep integration of technological and industrial innovation to achieve breakthroughs in developing new quality productive forces. It is essential for the island province to strengthen coordinated development with the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, deepen cooperation with the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the Yangtze River Delta and the Yangtze River Economic Belt, and deeply integrate into the Belt and Road cooperation to play a leading role in advancing high-standard opening up. As ecology is a great advantage for Hainan, it is imperative to safeguard such a "family legacy," adhere to coordination between land and sea, make continuous efforts to address prominent environmental issues, and advance the high-quality development of the national pilot zone for ecological conservation. It is essential to provide inclusive services, meet essential needs and provide a cushion for those most in need while improving people's well-being, resolve the pressing difficulties and problems that concern the people the most, and make solid progress toward common prosperity.

units.zh: 习近平强调，越是扩大开放，越要统筹发展和安全，牢牢守住安全底线。要科学有序安排开放节奏和进度，加强风险识别和防范，稳扎稳打、步步为营。
units.en: Xi stressed that the wider the door is opened, the more imperative it is to pursue development while ensuring security and firmly safeguard the red line for security. It is imperative to proceed the opening up in a sound and orderly manner, identify and prevent risks, and advance with steady and solid steps.
